import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds) for fiscal years 1929-1942
# From treasury_bulletin_1942_07_page_76.txt - in thousands of dollars
# The "Individual" column shows individual income tax collections

years = [1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942]
receipts_thousands = [1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800]

# Convert to billions (thousands / 1,000,000)
receipts = [r / 1000000 for r in receipts_thousands]

print("Data (year, receipts in billions):")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts):
    print(f"  {y}: {r:.6f}")

# Perform OLS regression
X = np.array(years)
y = np.array(receipts)

# Add intercept
X_with_intercept = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)), X])

# OLS: beta = (X'X)^-1 X'y
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X_with_intercept, y, rcond=None)[0]

intercept, slope = beta
print(f"\nOLS Results:")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f}")
print(f"  Equation: receipts = {intercept:.4f} + {slope:.4f} * year")

# Project for year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected = intercept + slope * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected for 2000: {projected:.4f} billion dollars")

# Actual for 2000 from treasury_bulletin_2001_12_page_17.txt
# The "Net" column for Income taxes (column 4) for year 2000 is 1,004,461 million = 1004.461 billion
actual_2000 = 1004461 / 1000  # Convert from millions to billions
print(f"Actual for 2000: {actual_2000:.4f} billion dollars")

# Difference (actual - projected)
difference = actual_2000 - projected
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference:.4f} billion dollars")

# Round to nearest tenths
difference_rounded = round(difference, 1)
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenths: {difference_rounded}")
EOF
